with the chain assumesAgentRole o hasRoleUnderName -> hasName it made a cycle of property chains, outside OWL 2 DL (no reasoner could answer); broken at the inverse that closes it - an agent who acts in a role still carries the role's name

the chain assumesAgentRole o hasRoleUnderName -> hasName makes hasName a non-simple property, and OWL 2 DL allows no cardinality restriction on one, so no reasoner could answer; this one - on the inverse of hasName - goes, the chain stays (keeping this and dropping that chain instead leaves assumesAgentRole in two cardinality restrictions)
